comment: He might be at a different school now, I'm not sure, but if he is still at Richmond,  he is your man for whatever classes you're taking that he is teaching. Great guy who really cares that you are learning while at the same time not making the class any harder than it needs to be. Easy to talk to, extremely helpful.

Really cares about his students. Wants them to learn the material and do well. Will help you in whatever way you need. Very nice guy overall. But Latin is a challenging subject area, so something to keep in mind.
